gate.provisional_timing: wall/load1 provisional: 4 vCPU Intel Xeon @ 2.10GHz, nproc 4, GATE_JOBS=1, box alone on its machine (the judge re-takes it)

probe.baseline_value: turn_on (two-zone, plan off now/next, room average 21.4 C, upper floor 15 C; likewise lower floor 15 C)
probe.run_from: a scratch baseline worktree at 92d38ecb (never the gate tree while a gate runs); thread_factor 1.000

should_fail.check_area: the space-pump rail checks ('rail: a zone near its floor forces the space pump on', features.py:~20340) and the coordinator pump glue
should_fail.why_it_passes: the zone rail is asserted on pump_schedule.space_pump_should_run called directly with zone_temps=[19.2]; no check drives _async_drive_pumps in a two-zone house, so the coordinator's assembly of the zone list is never read
should_fail.assertion_it_lacks: a two-zone coordinator with a warm room average and one floor below the comfort floor + SPACE_PUMP_FLOOR_MARGIN_C, plan off now and next, asserting turn_on

finding.title: No check fails when the space pump ignores a cold floor in a two-zone house (coordinator.py:4538)
finding.claim: With coordinator.py:4538 `if params.two_zone_enabled:` disabled, _async_drive_pumps turns the space pump OFF while a floor sits at 15 C under a 21.4 C room average (baseline turn_on via the comfort-floor rail), and the full gate stays green beyond its null.
finding.metric_definition: the homeassistant service _async_drive_pumps issues for the space pump in a two-zone house, plan off now and next, room average 21.4 C, one floor at 15 C
finding.mechanism: the comfort-floor rail is pinned only at pump_schedule level; the coordinator-side zone list (room + upper + lower in two-zone mode) has no check
finding.phenomenon_property: every guard/branch of this function changes an observable output on some reachable input, and the suite asserts that output on that input
finding.seam_rule: awk -F'\t' '$6=="gate"' SURVIVORS.tsv (the wave list) restricted to the function's cluster; each SURVIVED key is a seam
finding.proposed_fix_scope: tests only: add the missing assertion to the named closure script; no production change
